description: Hemoglobin 14.5 g/dL → 13.8 g/dL, within normal range
presentation: A 45-year-old man with a history of traveler's diarrhea and a reassuring colonoscopy 1 year ago presents asymptomatic but with a persistent positive FIT now five months after his initial positive result. His hemoglobin is 13.8 g/dL. His initial FIT several months ago was performed to assess prolonged diarrhea after an international trip. During his prior colonoscopy, three polyps were completely removed (pathology: one hyperplastic, two adenomas <1 cm; surveillance recommended in five years). What follow-up evaluation is recommended in light of his prior polyps and ongoing FIT positivity?
